author: Barnaby crumble

title: LIFE CHANGING
body:
Okay HOW does this work so well?! My mind is blown. Joined my first live yesterday and managed to get a whole pile of (very important) admin completed that I’d been putting off for SIX MONTHS. I feel so much lighter. Even if I never used it again, it was worth the annual subscription fee for that alone. (Although I will definitely be using this thing daily!!). Really enjoying the motivation from the lovely coaches, and also the focus rooms are awesome. I can see myself scheduling my day / certain tasks around lives going fwd. I felt a bit awkward at first putting my camera on, but it’s definitely more effective when you know you’re on show. There’s also something really nice about seeing other humans just doing ordinary human things. Laundry, washing dishes, admin, all the awesome and varied creative projects people do. I very quickly realised this was a judgement free zone and feel safe in this community.

I think Rox and Rich have created something truly extraordinary here. My absolute favourite thing about it is actually the follow-along videos. The fact they’re filmed in a normal home, not some manicured insta-worthy apartment, filmed on a phone in such a DIY, raw, unfiltered way is really where the magic is. The rest of the UX of the app is seamless and the layout is really clean and simple (not overstimulating at all and you can pick up how to use it in minutes). But the morning routing videos really got me. I even shed a little tear and laughed while following along. What an amazing way to help remove the shame that so many people with neurodivergence and trauma feel when struggling to get things done. 

Cannot recommend enough 💪

title: 5 stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
body:
I genuinely love the Dubbii app — it’s become one of my favorite apps to use daily. Everything about it feels well-designed and intentional, from how smooth the interface is to how well all the features actually work in real life. It’s incredibly easy to use, but still powerful, which is a hard balance to get right. Nothing feels confusing or cluttered, and everything just flows naturally, which makes staying organized and productive feel effortless instead of stressful.

The app runs really well with no bugs or lag, and it’s clear that a lot of thought went into making sure the user experience is actually enjoyable. It doesn’t feel like just another generic productivity app — it feels personal, motivating, and genuinely helpful. It’s one of those apps that you don’t just download and forget about, but actually keep using because it makes a real difference.

The only feature I would absolutely love to see added is a desk organization option. Something that helps with organizing physical desk setups, planning workspace layouts, or tracking desk organization ideas would be such an amazing addition. It would fit perfectly with the rest of the app’s purpose and vibe, and it would make it even more complete as an all-in-one organization and productivity tool.

Overall, Dubbii is an amazing app that clearly had a lot of care put into it, and I would 100% recommend it to anyone looking for a genuinely helpful, well-functioning, and enjoyable app. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

title: Best App for my ADHD (after trying others like Fabulous & Chillio which didn’t help)
body: This app is brilliant for three reasons: 1. Lived experience 2. Fun. 3. Community.  1. The developers have experience in dealing with ADHD, Autism, both in themselves and family. Therefore the videos are fit for purpose, and based on tried and tested methods, and are incredibly practical for getting the day to day, done. 2. Fun. The videos are an appropriate length, each task is divided into steps. They strike the right tone: a balance of fun but also authentic and they’ve included variations for different situations and moods. Their badge reward system measures progress, and doesn’t regress, just updates when you want to.  3. The live sessions are brilliant for when you’ve run out of energy and motivation. It helps to make your ‘To Dos’ became ‘Tah Dahs!’ Each session has a host who encourages action, empathises a little with blocks, cheers successes, and celebrates the community. ‘Dubbers’ in the chat, have the opportunity not only to share, but to cheer, send hugs, give reminders and generally give each other a boost of energy ‘Dubbii Dust’ and a sense of togetherness.  All this for just under £30 a year, which suits the budgets of students, people with limited income during this time of inflation. As I’m from a teaching background, I think this is one of the best things to come out of the online-universe - helping students to complete tasks, and helping people long undiagnosed, find some kind of support, as they sit on waiting lists, or wait to have enough money to pay for treatment and medication.  This app deserves to be given the Apple App of the year award… I think it’s amazing. My house is clean, my things are being organised, my body is cared for, and my long-shelved projects are getting attention again. It’s has added such value to my life, i hope it lasts for decades - and never compromises on its down-to-earth, accessibility.  Bravo Rox & Rich.

body: We’re not lazy, we just don’t have access to the right environments in order to succeed! Until now!! I’ve been using Dubbii for a month now and I’m genuinely in shock over how it’s changed my life already. My first live doubling session I washed up (usually I leave it for weeks at a time), and skip to now, it’s been done almost daily except for about 3 burnout days, I’ve showered regularly and my house is tidy! The hosts for the live sessions are like our personal cheer leaders and offer the most compassionate and positive vibes you could ever hope to find! All the dubbers are so supportive and I no longer feel alone in my daily challenges. This is seriously the best thing I’ve ever done and the nicest thing about it is that it’s FOR ME! And it helps ME live a life of authenticity and connection with others who understand and appreciate what it’s like to have brains like ours. Thank you SO SO much to Rox, Rich and the Dubbii team. You’re changing so many lives for the better! Thank you thank you thank you!!!! Xxx

Thank you so much!

author: japanmorgan

author: Officialdaszi

title: Love this App
body:
What a fantastic idea. I don’t have ADHD, but do have severe depression and anxiety. I am currently having time off work and was dreading being alone at home whilst everyone else working. Being alone = procrastinating and reduced motivation leading to feeling of guilt and shame. 
Only been attending live sessions a few days, but definitely feeling more motivated and beginning to get stuff done. Taking rests in between sessions and just getting on with it during the sessions. 
Never knew the power of body doubling before, but definitely a convert!
Amazing supportive community with no judgement. 
Thanks to all involved with producing this app 🎉
author: HellyMc

author: Luc Houston

title: This app is life-changing!
body:
Joined the app 3 months ago, I am awaiting an ADHD diagnosis and have been really struggling to get anything done, in particular showering and cleaning. The videos on the app breaking down all the steps to each of the tasks are so helpful and things feel less overwhelming when there’s a step by step and someone doing it along with you. 

I started using the live sessions in the last couple of weeks and they are so brilliant. It’s great to be in a lovely space full of likeminded people, all cheering you on to get whatever you need to do, done. The lives are helping me stay on task and on time because they provide much needed structure and accountability to my day. Would recommend this to anyone, I don’t know how I went without it before!

The live sessions are THE BEST thing ever and not only has it made me productive, it has also given me lots of friends and the community is amazing!!! Thank you!!!

title: Life changing
body:
These sessions have honestly changed my life. At the age of 30
I’ve gone from doing absolutely nothing but staying in bed on my days off work and having to call friends/family to come and help with daily chores due to becoming so overwhelmed with it all to actually getting out of bed at 8:30am ready to start my day! I attend all dubbii sessions throughout the day and my house has never looked so good! 
Nicki is absolutely amazing and her energy is contagious! Her tone, understanding, attitude and empathy is like no other! ❤️ 
Dubclub is a family and support network like no other! I never feel ashamed or embarrassed about the jobs I have to do. We’re a strong support network, even on some of our lonely/down days we know we’re not alone! 
Thank you so much ❤️❤️
Jay Kay ❤️

author: ‘This nickname is taken’

title: Life changing
body: It is no exaggeration to say that this app has changed my life. Having a clean, tidy and calming home has always been a dearly held yet unachievable dream of mine, until now. It is absolutely amazing how simply having a friendly, supportive guiding voice and body doubling video to walk me through tasks just removes all the mental clutter and confusion, and makes each step feel satisfying and doable. Each step is something I already know to do in theory, but have never been able to reliably do in practice because of overwhelm, decision fatigue and brain fog. Dubbii gently lifts all of that away. I also love how you don’t have to do a task every single day for it to found towards badges. Such a simple thing really helps to remove shame and pressure, and keeps the motivation going (I love seeing what the next little badge is going to be!). I could rave about this app forever; suffice to say it’s enabled me to achieve a dream I never thought possible - having a clean, tidy home that I can be proud of, and feel relaxed and happy in. Thank you forever!!!!!!!

author: Urbancowgirrrrl

title: Game changer!
body: As an adult with late-diagnosed ADHD, cleaning has always been a nearly insurmountable task. Lists, check sheets, routines, timers, rewards, etc.—nothing ever worked for me. This app changed all that, and it just keeps getting better!! I love the new “messy mode”; I honestly had been putting off using the app because I was afraid I was too far gone to be able to follow along. With “messy”, I got our out-of-control bedroom wrangled into something presentable and have the tools to keep it that way. It’s SO much more peaceful now; I’m not going to bed stressed out about the mess and clutter everywhere. I love that they’re just “regular folks”, not the typical TikTok influencers with perfect homes and perfect routines. Very relatable, and it feels like they’re really talking directly to you. I’m telling everyone I can about this app now; it’s amazing ❤️

author: squiresy1985

title: Perfect for anyone struggling with their Mental or Physical Health
body:
This app is life changing. At 35 years old with possible adhd/autism and a partner with likely autism, I've always struggled with time anxiety, procrastination, either clock watching or time blindness which makes me overwhelmed. I've got a pile of journals with to do lists and planners in effort to get organised and build up habits every adult should have but nothing stuck long term.

With this app, before I know it I've started a quick bed time routine, a morning routine. We have our laundry from the week put away. The key is not trying to be perfect and follow the clips you're interested in most at that time, and then set the nudge for next time. It sets it either for tomorrow for the daily things or the week for the weekly things which is great. 

Mondays, used to feel overwhelming, hunting for clean clothes or sleeping in too late for a shower before work. This morning I've had my shower in a clean bathroom. Our bedroom is tidy (did it yesterday!) I've now had my coffee and a glass of water and will have some breakfast and still have an hour to kill before work. Is this how it's supposed to be?! Followed you both for awhile and this app is like the cherry on the cake of content. Super grateful to you both. ❤️❤️❤️

author: merrynsmall

title: This app is absolutely amazing!
body:
I have officially used this app for more than a week and personally it has really improved how i feel physically and also about myself. I had always struggled with keeping a routine of personal hygiene like brushing teeth and having regular showers, but actually this app seriously helped me get motivated to do it and i chose the step by step option which slowed things down and helped me get it done. I would 100% recommend this to people, but i would also advise that before you pay for the subscription you choose to try one of the body doubling videos; maybe one that you know you struggle with or cant keep a routine with. I also love that there are options, so you could choose a step by step body doubling video or you could have the option to play some type of music while Rox or Rich are in the background doing the thing with you. 

This has made me feel amazing and supported while i do the boring stuff so i can (afterwards) let the dopamine depict what i do 😅.

Thank you so much and i also hope that my review has hopefully helped people get the help they might need by using this app.
author: Teflon Tic

title: What all Adhder’s have been waiting for!  Awesome!
body: So I thought I’d try this app, as I love ADHD love and wanted to support them, as they’ve helped me overcome a lot of shame about having adhd.  I thought it seemed a little basic as I’ve been working on my routines etc for years now… how wrong I was!  The thing with ADHD is when we are ‘on’ we are unstoppable, but when we crash it’s almost impossible to get us moving… this app solves that, as you do the task alongside them and it feels ‘real’ so you don’t want to quit on them!   Also you can choose to a complete a task with either of them, which is really fun!  Highly recommend this app and can see me using it a lot!  Well done guys! :D

author: Nan26!?

title: Rubadub dubbii
body:
Omg this is a game changer for housework!
Housework usually consists of the following cycle for me…

Start a job
Find another job that needs doing
Start that job
Make a great big mess as I go 
Feel totally overwhelmed
Get angry 
Cry 
Spend 12 hours like a cyclone until finally the house is clean and then I collapse and can’t move.

Today I used Dubbii for the first time and it’s blown me away. The simplicity and effectiveness is astonishing. I’ve managed to do a whole house clean (bar the doom piles which are up next 😬) and I’ve not felt overwhelmed, angry or cried..in fact I’ve kinda enjoyed it 😳😂

I love the little celebrate at the end of each task (great little dopamine boost) and the nudges of what needs doing and when.

Thank you Roxy and Rich 💚💚💚
